shapeSummary: Rectangular 38.1 x 26.7 x 1.6 mm PCB lying in the XZ plane (bottom at Y=0), with a 6-position screw terminal block on the right edge, a 10-pin header with pins on the left edge, a cylindrical electrolytic capacitor, a micro-USB housing on the back edge, and one 2.3 mm mounting hole at the front-left.
warnings: Dimensions are estimates; height of 12 mm is assumed.
The analysis bounds are given in Z-up form (x 38.1, y 26.7, z 12). They were remapped to Y-up so that the board depth runs along Z and the 12 mm height along Y, as the rules require.
Only the front-left mounting hole is clearly visible and is included. The second hole at (16.4, 9.6) was omitted because it is uncertain and would collide with the terminal block.
Component positions and sizes (terminal block, header, capacitor, USB) are approximated from the photo.
Small SMD parts, the large pad, castellations, and silkscreen are omitted.
cadquery:
pcb = cq.Workplane('XY').box(38.1, 1.6, 26.7, centered=(True, False, True))
hole = cq.Workplane('XZ').center(-14, 11.4).circle(1.15).extrude(-5)
pcb = pcb.cut(hole.translate((0, -1, 0)))
# 6-position screw terminal block along +X edge
term = cq.Workplane('XY').box(8, 8, 21, centered=(True, False, True)).translate((14.5, 1.6, 2))
# 10-pin header along -X edge
hdr = cq.Workplane('XY').box(2.54, 2.5, 25.4, centered=(True, False, True)).translate((-17.3, 1.6, 0)) if False else cq.Workplane('XY').box(2.54, 2.5, 22.86, centered=(True, False, True)).translate((-17.3, 1.6, 2))
pins = (cq.Workplane('XZ').pushPoints([(-17.3, 2 + (i - 4.5) * 2.54) for i in range(10)])
        .rect(0.64, 0.64).extrude(-8.5).translate((0, 1.6, 0)))
# electrolytic capacitor
cap = cq.Workplane('XZ').center(-5, 0).circle(3.15).extrude(-5.5).translate((0, 1.6, 0))
# micro-USB connector on back edge
usb = cq.Workplane('XY').box(8, 2.7, 5.5, centered=(True, False, True)).translate((-3, 1.6, -13.35 + 2.75 - 1.0))
part = pcb.union(term).union(hdr).union(pins).union(cap).union(usb)
